raw:
@q query
  select ?x
  except ?x "Rachel"
  where match
    relation "play for"
    role subject ?x
    role object "Cluj-Napoca Wolves"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?t
  measure duration
  where match
    relation "work at"
    role subject "Hao"
    role object "Carpathia Energy"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q3 query
  where match
    relation "depend on"
    role subject "the payroll database"
    role object "the reporting dashboard"
    polarity affirmed
  end
